entries.note: FT-91 corrected the symbol attribution. hot_owner.go holds BindHot, the HotOwner type and the whole live rule-binding surface (RuleImplementation, BindSelectedRuleDirect, BindExactWriteRule, BindExactQuery, ResolveRuleImplementation and the rest); it does not hold DeclareAxis, BindAxis, AlgebraAxis, AxisEntry or StructureSpecs, all of which live in registration.go. entries.note: This entry exists to refuse the reflex that the operand types die with the executor. SummaryVector, MemberCell and SelectedCell are the parameter types of permanently-authored reducers - SuspensionFold, SuspensionEvidenceFold, BeyondAllocations, resultClosed and the callsite/bodyresult/resultalias folds - none of which the ledger schedules for death. The surviving consumers use only SummaryVector.Valid/Count/At and SelectedCell.Value/Tag/Present: eight references across six files. The Form, Ticket and Scratch write machinery these two files also carry stays in S2 and dies. The restatement is the read-side value types alone, not the files as they stand. Fourteen non-test files depend on this restatement and on nothing else the cut deletes, so they are deliberately in no entry: effect/callsite/fold.go, heap/allocation/closed/rule.go, heap/formalfreeze/{core,routes}.go, heap/publicationfreeze/routes.go, placement/formal/{core,routes}.go, placement/returnescape/core.go, placement/suspension/{reducer,routes}.go, placement/transfer/{core,routes}.go, value/bodyresult/judgment.go and value/resultalias/judgment.go. Each needs one import rewritten, not a deletion. Seven of them carry the authored Builds the scheduled-death ledger still lists, so they shrink further as those rows empty.
